subject: Success metrics commitment and exec approval request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + proposed POC success criteria (next steps)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a suggested minimally scoped POC plan so we can align expectations and lock in timelines. I captured what we discussed on the call; please correct anything I got wrong.

Summary:
- Goal: Demonstrate a 2-week inference pilot that proves Redwood can reduce average autocompletion latency for triage workflows and maintain model quality compared to your current endpoint.
- Success metrics (proposed):
  - P95 generation latency <= 120ms (end-to-end) for 512-token requests
  - Cost per 1k tokens <= 60% of current baseline
  - No more than 2% drop in top-1 label accuracy on the provided evaluation set
  - KV cache hit rate >= 30% for common prefixes (we'll supply sample logs)
- Scope: subset of 3 production flows (Intake, Triage, Summary).
- Owners: Veridian (data + evaluation set) — Emma; Redwood (runtime, model variant selection, instrumentation) — Marissa & Ben.
- Tentative timeline: kickoff week of Feb 8, run Feb 10–24, internal readout week of Feb 25.

Attachments: I attached a short POC scope doc and an evaluation checklist to make it easier to pull people together.

Ask: Can you confirm the metrics above and whether the Feb 8 kickoff works for your team? If you prefer, we can shorten to 1 week by restricting to Intake flow only.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: veridian_poc_scope.pdf (2 pages; scope, owners, minimal infra), veridian_evaluation_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet of labeled cases)
From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@carelytics.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC success criteria (next steps)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we want to see. A few clarifications:

1) Latency: we measure in our app where network adds ~20ms. Can you confirm whether your target is client-observed or server-only? We expect P95 client-observed <= 150ms.
2) Accuracy: our internal label set is 1,200 examples; we can hand over a 500-case subset for the pilot.
3) Timeline: Feb 8 kickoff is tight for our security review. Can we shift kickoff to Feb 10 and still aim for a readout in the week of Feb 22–26?

If that works I'll route the NDA addendum and the security questionnaire to Rajiv for the tech review; he'll handle the SOC 2 evidence ask.

Emma
Head of Product
Veridian Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@veridianhealth.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@carelytics.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC success criteria (next steps)

Emma — great, thanks for the quick turn. Responses inline and plan adjustments below.

1) Latency: the target I proposed was server-side (Redwood runtime). We can convert to client-observed by adding your network delta; proposed P95 client-observed <= 150ms matches your ask. We'll instrument end-to-end timers.

2) Accuracy: 500-case subset is perfect for the initial gate — please send by EOD Wed Feb 10.

3) Timeline: Feb 10 kickoff is OK. Updated timeline: kickoff Feb 10; run Feb 11–24 (full 2-week run); readout windows Feb 25–26.

Security/Procurement: Monica will lead the SOC2 evidence handoff and will send the minimal artifact list. Ben will own model variant selection and optimization settings.

Next steps (short checklist):
- Veridian: share 500-case eval subset + sample logs by Feb 10 (Emma)
- Redwood: provide test endpoints, instrumentation dashboard, and baseline comparison script by Feb 11 (Ben)
- Security: Redwood SOC2 extract + short KMS statement (Monica)

I'll book a 30-minute kickoff for Feb 10 — tentative calendar invite attached.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: kickoff_invite.ics (calendar invite stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 07:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: POC plan & owners (please ack)

All —

Quick internal note so we have written ownership for the Veridian pilot before kickoff. Please reply with a quick ack and any constraints.

Owners and deliverables:
- Ben Carter: test endpoints, runtime config (fp16/q4/kv-cache), baseline cost comparison script, 2 automated load patterns (burst + steady) — due Feb 11 EOD
- Marissa Cole: customer comms, exec readout coordination, success criteria sign-off — ongoing, readout week Feb 25–26
- Monica Patel: SOC 2 artifacts, KMS integration notes, security point-of-contact for customer — provide artifact list Feb 10, deliverables as available
- Jonas Weber: telemetry dashboard and alerting (token-level cost, p95 latency panels) — dashboard ready Feb 12

Risks / mitigation:
- If the eval subset shows >3% accuracy drop, we will do a quick 48-hour tuning sprint and escalate to Emma with options (quantization adjustments, alternative model variant).
- If KV hit rate is below 20%, we'll instrument additional prefix caching and re-run a 48-hour pass.

Please ack.

- Ben
From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@carelytics.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Bcc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC success criteria (next steps) — final readout scheduling

Marissa / Ben —

Quick update from our side after the first week of runs: we're on track with latency and cost improvements; Rajiv's initial check on the SOC artifacts looks good. Two asks before we schedule the exec readout:

1) Can Redwood commit to delivering a 2-slide executive summary (metrics vs baseline, risks + recommended next step) 24 hours before the readout? That will help our leadership.
2) For the exec slot on Feb 25, we can do either 10:00–10:30 AM ET or 3:00–3:30 PM ET. Which works on your side?

If you can confirm the exec summary commitment and pick the 10:00 ET slot, we'll confirm the attendee list (includes our CTO and VP Product).

Thanks,
Emma
